commit.message:
Require proof of burn for coin imports in ConnectBlock

ConnectBlock skipped input and fee accounting for every IsMint()
transaction. IsMint() matches coin imports as well as the coinbase, so
an import-shaped transaction (one input with prevout.n == 1000000000)
in a block never reached ContextualCheckInputs, where VerifyCoinImport
runs, and its outputs were accepted with no proof of a burn. Only the
coinbase now takes that branch; imports are validated as before
v6.0.0.

Adds two tests that connect a block carrying a forged import, one with
a malformed scriptSig and one with a well-formed import scriptSig and a
bogus payload, and expect it to be rejected with invalid-coin-import.
